classification.difficultyReason: Read unit-width bar heights into frequency tables while distinguishing class-boundary labels from integer labels at bar centres.

inlines.text: Given the frequency histogram, find the corresponding frequency table.

spec.description: Five adjacent unshaded bars; class-boundary labels 4 through 9, vertical ticks 1 through 5, arrowheads on both axes and horizontal-axis title X.
spec.answerVisibility: The supplied histogram is permanently visible; the response frequency table appears only in answer content.

inlines.text: The horizontal labels mark class boundaries. Each class has width 1, so its frequency equals its bar height.

spec.sourceRegion: Upper-left practice column, histogram labelled 12, to the right of histogram 11
spec.description: Five adjacent unshaded equal-width bars with integer score labels 3 through 7 at their centres, vertical ticks 1 through 7, arrowheads on both axes and horizontal-axis title X.
spec.answerVisibility: The supplied histogram is permanently visible; the response frequency table appears only in answer content.

inlines.text: The integer labels are at the bar centres, so record the individual scores. Each bar has unit width, so its frequency equals its height.
